the implementation and scaling up of effective primary health care (screening, brief advice and referral to specialist treatment) for alcohol use disorder (heavy drinking) in three Latin American countries.
the implementation of effective PHC based prevention of AUD and the extent to which it can be scaled up by the use of supportive municipal action.
